name: AI PixFix
tagline: AI PixFix is a free all-in-one online toolkit for images and PDFs — no signup, no watermarks, no uploads to a server
description: AI PixFix is a free all-in-one online toolkit for images and PDFs — no signup, no watermarks, no uploads to a server. Every tool runs 100% in your browser, so your files never leave your device. We cover 60+ tools across four areas: • Image editing — remove or replace backgrounds, resize, crop, compress, add text, watermark, blur faces, censor, generate favicons, create collages, memes, ASCII and pixel art, apply filters (preset, B&W, sepia), pick colors, strip metadata. • Image conversion — PNG
